subtopic: Revenue Metrics (MRR, ARR, ARPU, Net Revenue Retention)
question_text: [BI Dashboards & Visual Analytics (PowerBI/Tableau/Metabase) - Q09] If a SaaS company begins the month with $100k Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR), loses $10k to churn, loses $5k to downgrades, and gains $25k in expansion from existing accounts, what is its Net Revenue Retention (NRR)?
answer_explanation: NRR = (Starting MRR - Churn - Downgrades + Expansion) / Starting MRR = (100 - 10 - 5 + 25) / 100 = 110 / 100 = 110%. NRR > 100% indicates negative net churn.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: NRR = (Starting MRR - Churn - Downgrades + Expansion) / Starting MRR = (100 - 10 - 5 + 25) / 100 = 110 / 100 = 110%. NRR > 100% indicates negative net churn.
